title: [Fabric] Exclude tables and fields for Fabric integration
summary: Added table and field validation logic to the Fabric integration to control which Business Central tables and fields can be mirrored to Microsoft Fabric.
key_points: New Fabric Table Validation codeunit for excluding tables from Fabric integration
New Fabric Field Validation codeunit for excluding fields
Fabric Exp Activate and Fabric Exp Admin permission sets updated for the new codeunits
